_note: The Commander Blog — the communication officer's daily entry — for the thirteen days of the run (Thursday 15 to Tuesday 27 October 2026), keyed by mission day then by officer: 13 slots, COMMUNICATION OFFICER only. The station has three blogs: this one, the Daily Science Findings and the Daily Health Blog (the SCIENCE and HEALTH notes in notes.json, written on the science and health officers' tabs). Entries for any other officer here are ignored. A slot beginning with [PLACEHOLDER] is a slot to write into: its first line is shown greyed on the public crew log, the rest is a cue shown only in mission control. Write over it here or in mission control (Communication officer → Commander Blog); save it empty and the placeholder comes back.
